body:
𝌋 **Causal correction after #1553**

The original #1553 D/Grove countercontrol omitted the actual server entrypoint `api/khonapolit.js`, whose ordinary text branch wraps the handler with `withGeminiGenerationProfile(GEMINI_GENERATION_PROFILE_KHONAPOLIT_INTERACTIVE, ...)`. This maps Gemini 3.8 Flash HIGH→MEDIUM (and Argon HIGH→MEDIUM). Thus the originally asserted **D MEDIUM vs Grove HIGH** divergence was a constructor-only artifact, not a real text-route contrast.

This PR corrects the reconstructed Grove countercontrol to invoke the same profile as the live text HTTP boundary; changes its expectations to **D MEDIUM == ordinary Grove 3.8 MEDIUM**, asserts the actual HTTP wrapper source and profile mapping, and revises the research interpretation while retaining #1553's valid purely hypothetical matched MEDIUM/HIGH request pair.

User observation: Gemini app both HIGH and MEDIUM support attractor basin performance; HIGH preferred creatively. Prior paid comparison proposal #1554 was CLOSED unmerged and **never activated**, with zero provider calls. Focus returns to the same-MEDIUM D ingress/heading/persona factors (#1551), not Argon blame or local typography stencils.

No app changes, no provider calls, no #405 Vercel work. Require exact-head CI before merge.

𝄐 ACTUAL_HTTP_PROFILE_IDENTIFIED · HIGH_CONFUND_RETRACTED · SOURCE_CAUSE_HELD. Sealed ⟐
title: fix(research): recover actual Marrowline interactive MEDIUM profile versus neutral D
